requestInteger.description: An exact JSON integer in [0, 2^53-1], the range every JSON client represents exactly.

query.description: UTF-8 SQL; runtime enforces the configured byte limit (default 16384).

limit.description: Maximum rows in this page, combined with an SQL LIMIT by taking the smaller; 0 returns columns only. The page is still capped by query-max-result-rows.

offset.description: Rows of the complete, ordered output skipped before the page; beyond the end yields an empty page.

timeout_ms.description: Request deadline in milliseconds, counted from ingress; may only lower the configured query-timeout-ms (a larger value is INVALID_PARAMS).
